:::{#sol-cross-entropy-general-sum}

Let $g(k) \eqdef -\log q_k$,
so that $-\log q_X = g(X)$.
Since $q_k > 0$ whenever $p_k > 0$,
$g(k)$ is finite for every value $k$ that $X$ takes with positive [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability).
By [LOTUS](#thm-lotus),

$$
\ba
\crossentropyf{p}{q}
&= \E{-\log q_X} \\
&= \E{g(X)} \\
&= \sum_{k : p_k > 0} g(k) \cd \P(X = k) \\
&= -\sum_{k : p_k > 0} p_k \log q_k \\
&= -\sumto{k}{K} p_k \log q_k.
\ea
$$

The last line adds the terms with $p_k = 0$,
which are $0$ by the convention in @thm-cross-entropy-discrete.

:::
